description.value: CinCin Ristorante + Bar is a long-established Italian restaurant on Robson Street, accessed by a winding stone stairway above street level. The kitchen is anchored by a Grillworks Infierno, a two-metre wood-fired grill and rotisserie where fish and prime meats are cooked over fruitwood charcoal alongside housemade pastas. With over 25 years of operation and a nationally recognized wine program, it is considered one of Vancouver's premier fine-dining Italian destinations.
